Note:
- Signed with the production Kuro Anime release certificate so it installs cleanly
  as an in-place upgrade over v1.5.3 / earlier 1.5.4-beta without wiping history.
- GitHub Releases and main branch remain on v1.5.3 (official public release).

What's Included in 1.5.4-beta:
1. Signature Violet Default Theme Across the Entire App:
   - Signature Violet (#a65be4) is now the default colour across all screens,
     startup splash, Settings accent preview, native dialogs, system bars, player
     controls, and Android TV banner.
   - Automatically migrates installs that were still on the old default teal once,
     while keeping all 20 custom accent colours selectable in Settings.

2. Strong Performance & Compatibility Architecture (Zero Scroll/Animation Changes):
   - Built-in Smart Encrypted DNS (DoH) unblock across Cloudflare (1.1.1.1/1.0.0.1),
     Google (8.8.8.8), and Quad9 (9.9.9.9) with automatic IPv4 + IPv6 fallback when
     carriers block anime domains, plus pooled HTTP/2 connections across catalogue,
     posters, sources, and native HLS playback.
   - Automatic ExoPlayer hardware-to-software video decoder fallback in both online
     and offline players so older or picky phone/TV chips play smoothly instead of
     showing a black screen.
   - Non-blocking background temporary cache scanner and 1-tap "Clear temporary
     stream cache" action in Settings -> Network & compatibility (never touches
     accounts, watchlists, history, or offline downloads).
   - Android TV / Fire TV Leanback launcher & banner support, foldable screen
     continuity without player restarts, automatic low-memory cache trimming
     (onTrimMemory / onLowMemory), and WebView crash-recovery shields.

3. Hardened Multi-Layer Player Popup & In-Page-Push Ad Blocker:
   - Blocks Adsterra Social Bar, ExoClick In-Page Push, Monetag, Galaksion, AdCash,
     AdSpyglass, Clickadu, HilltopAds, and floating adult fake-notification banners
     at both the WebView network layer and Shadow DOM / document-start cosmetic layer.

4. Android 15 (targetSdk 35) Edge-to-Edge Status Bar & Gesture Bar Window Fix:
   - Native WindowInsetsCompat padding keeps top headers clear of system status bar
     icons while preserving true edge-to-edge fullscreen playback.

5. Unified Account Hub (#3) + 24 Manga Face PFPs & Matching 16:9 Banners (art-11..34).
